warning.titlePre: Jaguar XJ 3.0d Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJD-V6 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJD-V6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJD-V6 rebuild.
Because the XJ 3.0d uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XJ 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJD-V6 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
